sources.title: Broncos pass rush has returned with a fury through eight games
sources.description: While the sack numbers are a bit off pace to the previous two seasons, the pressure rate is actually higher. The Denver Broncos defense is forcing quarterbacks to get rid of the ball quick or face the consequences. The reason the sacks are off pace is due to the competition this defense has faced.
